item.title: Doctor didn’t think ‘friendly and calm’ B.C. man was suicidal before family died
item.description: A doctor testifying at an inquest into the death of a couple and their two children in Prince Rupert, B.C., in 2023 says the father told him he had no suicidal or homicidal intent, three days before their bodies were found.

item.title: Multiple schools in Coquitlam under hold-and-secure measures after phoned-in threats
item.description: The Coquitlam RCMP has put multiple schools in Coquitlam on hold-and-secure after those schools received alleged phoned-in threats on Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: Canadian snowboarder Mark McMorris crashes during big air training
item.description: Canada opened competition at the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics on Wednesday with a win in mixed doubles curling, while concern grew after snowboarder Mark McMorris crashed during big air training in Livigno. McMorris was taken off the big air course on a stretcher Wednesday night following the crash, and his condition was not immediately known. The Canadian Olympic Committee […]

item.title: 2026 NHL draft prospect Gavin McKenna facing assault charges
item.description: Canadian hockey player Gavin McKenna, a top prospect for the 2026 NHL draft, is facing assault charges. McKenna, a freshman at Penn State, has been charged with aggravated assault by police in State College, Pa. He’s also charged with misdemeanour simple assault, disorderly conduct, engaging in fighting and harassment. The incident date listed in the filing […]

item.title: IHIT investigating suspicious disappearance of 45-year old man in Burnaby
item.description: The Integrated Homicide Investigation Team (IHIT) is seeking public assistance in locating missing 45-year-old Masood Masjoody.

item.title: Charges upgraded in homicide of 30-year old woman in Abbotsford
item.description: The BC Prosecution Service says the suspect in the homicide of a 30-year-old woman in Abbotsford is now facing charges of first-degree murder.

item.title: Parents rally to keep the Queensborough school bus funded
item.description: Parents and other community members were rallying outside the New Westminster Secondary School on Wednesday for the continuation of the Queensborough school bus program.

item.title: Asylum claims won’t stop extortion suspects facing justice: Immigration Department
item.description: Canada's Immigration Department says claiming asylum "cannot, and will not" prevent criminals being punished, after British Columbia's premier criticized refugee claims by extortion suspects as "ludicrous."

item.title: ‘We live here. This is where we run our businesses’: Surrey extortion victim glad about community advisory committee
item.description: A Surrey radio host and extortion victim says that establishing a community advisory board to combat the extortion crisis is a step in the right direction.

item.title: 2 people charged after bear-spray robbery in East Vancouver
item.description: Two men have been charged with one count of assault with a weapon and one count of theft under $5000 after an alleged robbery in Vancouver on Monday.
